name: Angel Halo
original_name: Angel Halo－エンジェル・ハイロウ－
source:
The protagonist, Kusakabe Makoto, is living a normal school life without knowing he is the reincarnation of Lucifer. One day an angel named Sofia and a demon named Lilith come to him. They are the messengers of Heaven and Hell. The day of Lucifer's judgement is approaching.

[Translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angel_Halo]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
主人公草壁真过着普通的校园生活，并不知道自己是路西法的转世。某天，天使索菲亚与恶魔莉莉丝来到他身边。她们分别是天堂与地狱的使者。路西法受审之日正在临近。

[译自[url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angel_Halo]日语维基百科[/url]]
